page.overview:
Who is Salome Gray?

Salome Gray is a fictional character by Dan Wickline for the comic book Grimm Fairy Tales Presents: Call of Wonderland Vol 1 2, published by Zenescope Entertainment in 2012.

Salome Gray is a tattoo artist that runs a tattoo parlor called Anarchy Ink. She and her friend Julie Sands were inadvertently drawn into an attempt by the forces of Wonderland to invade Earth. They vanquished their foes and returned to Earth, but were soon drawn back into Wonderland by the power of the Queen of Spades, who needed them to fill the role of the Queen of Hearts in Wonderland.

Category:Humans Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
